displayName: Publix API - Weekly Ad, BOGO Deals, Store Prices, Pub Subs
description: Publix API for publix.com, store by store - the weekly ad (about 700 items a week, about 230 Buy 1 Get 1 Free) with start and end dates, deal type, sale price, multi-buy and BOGO parsing; Extra Savings; digital coupons (listed, never clipped); one search across all three; product search and category listings, 48 per page with sorts and on-sale, BOGO and brand filters, aisle and promo; product cards with nutrition facts by Publix item code; the deli and bakery order-ahead menu with each store's Pub Sub prices; the category tree; a store locator with each store's weekly-ad start day; and search suggestions. Prices only where Publix shows them (items on promotion and order-ahead items), null otherwise. 11 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
